description: ICT High-probability Execution Models including 3-Candle FVG, 50% Consequent Encroachment, Silver Bullet, ICT 2022 Model, and Invalidation Criteria.

topics.name: Fair Value Gap (FVG / 3-Candle Imbalance)

deterministic_criteria.bullish_bisi: Candle 3 Low > Candle 1 High. FVG Top = Candle 3 Low, FVG Bottom = Candle 1 High
deterministic_criteria.bearish_sibi: Candle 3 High < Candle 1 Low. FVG Top = Candle 1 Low, FVG Bottom = Candle 3 High
deterministic_criteria.displacement_candle: Candle 2 must have body ratio |Close - Open| / (High - Low) >= 0.70

rules: FVG is a 3-candle imbalance representing single-sided aggressive price delivery.
Smart money re-delivers price back into the FVG to offer fair value to the opposing side before expanding.

topics.name: Consequent Encroachment (50% CE)

deterministic_criteria.entry_execution: Limit order placed exactly at 50% CE
deterministic_criteria.mitigation_threshold: Subsequent candle low/high touching or crossing 50% CE flags mitigation
deterministic_criteria.invalidation_warning: Candle body close beyond 50% CE signals structural weakness

rules: 50% CE is the equilibrium of the imbalance and the optimal institutional entry point.
Wicks may briefly pierce past 50% CE, but candle bodies should respect and close within the FVG.

topics.name: Silver Bullet Model

setup_sequence: 1. Liquidity sweep of external swing or session high/low
2. Violent displacement candle creating clean FVG

rules: Silver Bullet executes strictly during algorithmically programmed 60-minute time injections.
Zero hesitation model: enter at 50% CE of the first valid FVG formed after liquidity raid.

topics.name: ICT 2022 Mentorship Model

deterministic_criteria.step_1_htf: Price reaches key HTF liquidity pool or session extreme
deterministic_criteria.step_2_sweep: Deterministic sweep of BSL (for sells) or SSL (for buys)
deterministic_criteria.step_3_mss: Displacement candle closes body through structural pivot (MSS)
deterministic_criteria.step_4_fvg: 3-candle FVG created inside the displacement leg
deterministic_criteria.step_6_sl: Stop loss placed behind swing extreme of the sweep
deterministic_criteria.step_7_tp: Minimum 1:2.0 Risk-to-Reward ratio to opposing swing pool

rules: Requires confluence of Liquidity Sweep + Displacement MSS + Unmitigated FVG + 1:2.0 R:R.

topics.name: Unicorn Model

deterministic_criteria.confluence: Breaker Block and Fair Value Gap share identical price coordinates

rules: When a Breaker Block overlaps perfectly inside an FVG, it produces maximum institutional defense.
Offers the highest statistical win-rate in the entire ICT playbook.

topics.name: Inversion FVG (IFVG)

deterministic_criteria.condition: Price violates an existing FVG with full candle body close without reversal
deterministic_criteria.flip: Former Bullish FVG flips to Bearish Resistance; former Bearish FVG flips to Bullish Support

rules: A failed FVG becomes an Inversion FVG upon decisive breakout.
Retest of the inverted FVG provides high-confidence continuation entry.
